events.subtitle: Four Nights With... — multi-night album spotlights
lineup: They Might Be Giants — eight-piece touring band including a three-piece horn section; individual touring personnel are not listed on the official tour page
events.factual_description: They Might Be Giants plays four consecutive nights at 9:30 Club in Washington, DC from November 19 through November 22, 2026. Live Nation and Ticketmaster list the four-night engagement and passes, while I.M.P./9:30 Club publishes the individual dates. The band's official tour page describes the current format as an eight-piece band with three horns, two full sets and no opener: the opening set spotlights a different album each night, while two unique second sets draw across the catalog and include songs from the 2026 album The World Is to Dig. Apple Music dates the band's self-titled debut to November 4, 1986, making the 2026 engagement part of its 40th-anniversary year. The official 9:30 Club pages publish 7:00 PM doors; the artist says the tour is usually on stage at 8:00 PM sharp, but because that language is not event-specific, no exact showtime is stored here.

enrichment.note: The exact four-night Live Nation event page, exact authorized Ticketmaster four-night pass destination, official artist tour-format page and two exact Apple Music album pages are verified. Exact stage times are deliberately omitted because the official venue pages label 7:00 PM as doors and the artist's 8:00 PM statement is general to the tour rather than event-specific.

Repository search found no pre-existing They Might Be Giants RADAR record before publication. No unannounced touring personnel, album assignment by night, exact stage time or individual-night ticket availability was inferred.

en.why_it_matters: Four nights at 9:30 Club turns a catalog-heavy rock show into something closer to a small residency. The current eight-piece setup adds three horns, each opening set centers a different album, and the second halves are built to vary while pulling from four decades of deliberately odd pop craft and new 2026 material. In the 40th-anniversary year of the self-titled debut, the value is not nostalgia alone: it is hearing a band that still treats arrangement, timbre, humor and structural left turns as part of the live language.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one night in the DMV, and consider two if the album spotlights make the programs meaningfully different for you. Four consecutive shows create enough access that there is no need to treat the engagement as scarce, but 9:30 Club is a particularly good scale for the horn-heavy version of this band.
en.listen_before: They Might Be Giants — They Might Be Giants; The World Is to Dig

es.why_it_matters: Cuatro noches en el 9:30 Club convierten un concierto de catálogo en algo mucho más parecido a una pequeña residencia. La formación actual crece a ocho músicos con tres metales, cada primer set gira alrededor de un disco distinto y las segundas mitades cambian mientras recorren cuatro décadas de pop deliberadamente raro junto con material nuevo de 2026. En el año 40 del debut homónimo, la gracia no es sólo la nostalgia: es escuchar a una banda que todavía usa el arreglo, el timbre, el humor y los cambios de dirección como parte central de su lenguaje en vivo.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a una de las noches en el DMV, y consideraría dos si los discos elegidos vuelven realmente distintos los programas. Cuatro funciones consecutivas dan suficiente acceso para no tratar la residencia como escasa, pero la escala del 9:30 Club le queda especialmente bien a esta versión de la banda con metales.
es.listen_before: They Might Be Giants — They Might Be Giants; The World Is to Dig
